changes.old_notes: The scripture-bearing propers are recorded by their printed citations, and the day's orations, the Collect, the Secret and the Postcommunion, carry published Latin bodies collated to the controlling 1962 edition, each on the public-domain witness its row in src/sources/inventories/roman-1962-proper-latin-provenance-v1.toml names; the day's other composed chants are appointed but not yet transcribed.
changes.new_notes: The scripture-bearing propers are recorded by their printed citations, and the day's orations, the Collect, the Secret and the Postcommunion, carry published Latin bodies collated to the controlling 1962 edition, each on the public-domain witness its row in src/sources/inventories/roman-1962-proper-latin-provenance-v1.toml names; the complete two-versicle Alleluia now has its own independently source-qualified Latin body, while scriptural citation availability and full Missal wording remain separate.
changes.reason: The newly admitted complete own Alleluia supersedes this mass-level statement that the other composed chants are untranscribed; no whole-Mass or scriptural wording completeness is asserted.
